interpretation.runtime_order: the four pre-unit probes occur in array order; unit_dag may use any dependency-respecting topological order with jobs=1; each node and nested child occurs exactly once
interpretation.matching: substitute the target row and three fresh Rust scratch names, then compare program,cwd,argv,role,multiplicity,edges,depth exactly
interpretation.clang_config: every clang process loads the inventoried /mpk/toolchain/bin/clang.cfg before explicit argv and launches exactly its recorded ld.lld child
interpretation.cargo_run_freshness: after the successful build, nested cargo run has only the one recorded fuzz-target child and no rustc,build-script,proc-macro,or native-tool child

substitutions.rule: replace every complete uppercase token occurrence, including its occurrence inside one path element

substitutions.scope: four matching occurrences across libc-build-script-compile-linker and its backend
four matching occurrences across libfuzzer-sys-build-script-compile-linker and its backend
four matching occurrences across fuzz-target-bin-linker and its backend

prebuilt_libfuzzer.template_expansion: in sources array order, SOURCE is the complete source basename and OBJECT is that basename with final .cpp replaced by .o

invalid_cases.mutation: selected image link resolves outside the merged image
remove or change the inventoried clang.cfg bytes
ELF DT_NEEDED SONAME has no projection candidate
two search roots resolve one SONAME to unequal terminal bytes
main or driver requests a SONAME outside the frozen closure
treat an unregistered slash expression as SPDX
libfuzzer build script launches clang++ during bounded smoke
change one rustc or linker argv element
omit or reparent one clang-to-ld.lld child
run libfuzzer-sys library before its build script
nested cargo run launches any rustc child
swap two prebuilt libFuzzer source expansions
fixed key occupied by unequal bytes
